units.locator: Article 19. Setting standards in procurement
units.text: 2) general rules for determining requirements for particular types of goods, works and services procured by contracting authorities, including their maximum prices, and standard costs of supporting the functions of state bodies, governing bodies of state extrabudgetary funds and municipal bodies, including their respective territorial bodies and subordinate treasury institutions.
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Setting standards in procurement
units.text: 4. In accordance with the general rules provided for by part 3 of this Article, the Government of the Russian Federation, the highest executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and local administrations shall establish rules for setting standards in procurement of goods, works and services to meet federal needs, the needs of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and municipal needs, respectively (hereinafter, standard-setting rules), including:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Setting standards in procurement
units.text: 1) requirements for drafting and adopting legal acts on procurement standards, their content and ensuring their implementation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Setting standards in procurement
units.text: 2) rules for determining requirements for particular types of goods, works and services procured by state bodies, governing bodies of state extrabudgetary funds and municipal bodies, their respective territorial bodies, and treasury institutions, budget-funded institutions and state or municipal unitary enterprises subordinate to those bodies, including maximum prices of such goods, works and services, and standard costs of supporting the functions of state bodies, governing bodies of state extrabudgetary funds and municipal bodies, including their respective territorial bodies and subordinate treasury institutions.
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Setting standards in procurement
units.text: 4.1. The general standard-setting rules established by the Government of the Russian Federation under part 3 of this Article and the standard-setting rules provided for by part 4 of this Article shall apply to the State Atomic Energy Corporation “Rosatom”, the State Corporation for Space Activities “Roscosmos”, and the most significant institutions of science, education, culture and health care designated in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Setting standards in procurement
units.text: 5. On the basis of standard-setting rules established under part 4 of this Article, state bodies, governing bodies of state extrabudgetary funds, municipal bodies, and the most significant institutions of science, education, culture and health care designated in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation shall approve requirements for particular types of goods, works and services procured by them, their territorial bodies (divisions), and their subordinate treasury institutions, budget-funded institutions and state or municipal unitary enterprises, including maximum prices of such goods, works and services, and/or standard costs of supporting the functions of those bodies and their subordinate treasury institutions.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Setting standards in procurement
units.text: 6. Standard-setting rules, requirements for particular types of goods, works and services, including their maximum prices, and/or standard costs of supporting the functions of state bodies, governing bodies of state extrabudgetary funds and municipal bodies, including their respective territorial bodies and subordinate treasury institutions, shall be published in the unified information system.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Setting standards in procurement
units.text: 7. In accordance with the standard-setting rules provided for by part 4 of this Article, the State Atomic Energy Corporation “Rosatom” and the State Corporation for Space Activities “Roscosmos” shall approve requirements for particular types of goods, works and services procured by them and their subordinate organizations, including maximum prices of such goods, works and services, and/or standard costs of supporting their functions.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 20. Public discussion of procurement
units.text: Article 20. Public discussion of procurement
units.label: Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Public discussion of procurement
units.text: 1. A contracting authority shall conduct public discussion of procurement to discuss publicly whether the planned procurement complies with legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Public discussion of procurement
units.text: 2. Public discussion of procurement shall be held where tenders or auctions are conducted with an initial (maximum) contract price of two billion rubles or more, except where:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Public discussion of procurement
units.text: 1) procurement is conducted using closed methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers);
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Public discussion of procurement
units.text: 2) procurement is conducted to meet federal needs under the state defence order.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Public discussion of procurement
units.text: 3. The Government of the Russian Federation, the highest executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation and a local administration may lower the initial (maximum) contract price threshold at which public discussion under part 2 of this Article is required for procurement to meet federal needs, the needs of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation and municipal needs, respectively.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Public discussion of procurement
units.text: 4. Procurement subject to public discussion under parts 2 and 3 of this Article may not be conducted without such discussion.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Public discussion of procurement
units.text: 5. Public discussion of procurement shall begin when a schedule containing information on procurement subject to public discussion is published in the unified information system and shall end on the last day of the period for cancelling procurement provided for under part 1 of Article 36 of this Federal Law. If procurement is cancelled under this Federal Law, public discussion of that procurement shall end when the cancellation notice is published in the unified information system under part 2 of Article 36 of this Federal Law. Where this Federal Law does not require a schedule to be prepared, public discussion shall begin when the procurement notice is published in the unified information system.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Public discussion of procurement
units.text: 6. Any legal entities and individuals, including those registered as individual entrepreneurs, state bodies and local self-government bodies may participate on equal terms in public discussion of procurement by publishing comments and/or proposals on the official website during the discussion period, after registering in the unified information system for that purpose under its operating rules established pursuant to part 2 of Article 4 of this Federal Law. Such comments and/or proposals shall be published on the official website no later than the day following their receipt, after preliminary screening to exclude comments and/or proposals containing obscene language, conducted by one or more federal executive bodies designated under part 6 of Article 4 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Public discussion of procurement
units.text: 7. Within two working days starting on the day following publication on the official website of comments and/or proposals under part 6 of this Article, the contracting authority shall publish reasoned replies addressing their substance on the official website.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Public discussion of procurement
units.text: 8. After examining comments and/or proposals from participants in the public discussion, the contracting authority may, in accordance with this Federal Law, amend the schedule, procurement notice or draft contract, or cancel the procurement.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 21. Repealed
units.text: Article 21. Repealed
units.label: Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Repealed from 1 October 2019. — Federal Law of 01.05.2019 No. 71-FZ.
units.text: Article 21. Repealed from 1 October 2019. — Federal Law of 01.05.2019 No. 71-FZ.
units.label: Art. 21

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.label: Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 1. The initial (maximum) contract price and, in the cases provided for by this Federal Law, the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) shall be determined and justified by the contracting authority using one or more of the following methods:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 1) comparable market prices (market analysis) method;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 2) standards-based method;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 3) tariff method;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 4) design and cost-estimate method;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 5) cost-based method.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 2. The comparable market prices (market analysis) method consists of setting the initial (maximum) contract price, or the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), on the basis of market price information for goods, works or services identical to those planned for procurement, or, where such items are unavailable, for similar goods, works or services.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 3. When the comparable market prices (market analysis) method is used, price information for goods, works or services must be obtained taking account of commercial and/or financial terms of supply, performance or provision comparable to the terms of the planned procurement.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 4. When using the comparable market prices (market analysis) method, the contracting authority may use coefficients or indices it has justified to adjust prices of goods, works or services to account for differences in goods’ characteristics and in commercial and/or financial terms of supply, performance or provision.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 5. For the comparable market prices (market analysis) method, the following may be used: publicly accessible information on market prices of goods, works or services under part 18 of this Article; price information obtained at the contracting authority’s request from suppliers (contractors, service providers) supplying goods, works or services identical to those planned for procurement, or, where those are unavailable, similar goods, works or services, if the contracting authority obtains such information; and information obtained by publishing requests for prices of goods, works or services in the unified information system, if the contracting authority obtains such information.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 6. The comparable market prices (market analysis) method has priority for determining and justifying the initial (maximum) contract price and the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider). Other methods may be used in the cases provided for by parts 7–11 of this Article.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 7. The standards-based method consists of calculating the initial (maximum) contract price and the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) on the basis of requirements for the procured goods, works or services established under Article 19 of this Federal Law, where those requirements provide for maximum prices of goods, works or services.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 8. A contracting authority shall use the tariff method where, under legislation of the Russian Federation, prices of goods, works or services procured to meet state and municipal needs are subject to state regulation or are set by municipal legal acts. In that case, the initial (maximum) contract price and the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) shall be determined using the regulated prices (tariffs) of the goods, works or services.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 9. The design and cost-estimate method consists of determining the initial (maximum) contract price and the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) for:
units.label: Part 9 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 1) construction, reconstruction, major repairs or demolition of a capital construction project, based on design documentation and in accordance with methodologies and standards (state elemental cost-estimate standards) for construction works and specialized construction works approved, within their respective competence, by the federal executive body responsible for state policy and regulatory legal regulation in construction or by an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 9 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 2) works to preserve cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation, excluding scientific and methodological guidance, technical supervision and designer supervision, based on design documentation for cultural heritage preservation works approved in the manner established by legislation of the Russian Federation, and in accordance with restoration standards and rules approved by the federal executive body authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation in the field of state protection of cultural heritage sites.
units.label: Point 2 Part 9 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 9.1. The design and cost-estimate method may be used to determine and justify the initial (maximum) contract price and the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) for routine repairs of buildings, structures, facilities and premises.
units.label: Part 9.1 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 9.2. When the design and cost-estimate method is used to determine the initial (maximum) price of a contract, or the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), for construction, reconstruction, major repairs or demolition of capital construction projects or for cultural heritage preservation works, that determination shall be made in the manner established by this Federal Law, based on the estimated cost of construction, reconstruction or major repairs of capital construction projects determined under Article 8.3 of the Urban Planning Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 9.2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 10. The cost-based method shall be used where the other methods provided for by points 1–4 of part 1 of this Article cannot be used, or in addition to other methods. It consists of determining the initial (maximum) contract price and the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) as the sum of costs incurred and the profit customary in the relevant sphere of activity. Direct and indirect costs customary in such cases for producing or acquiring and/or selling goods, works or services, as well as transport, storage, insurance and other costs, shall be taken into account.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 11. A contracting authority may obtain information on customary profit and direct and indirect costs in a particular sphere of activity by analysing contracts published in the unified information system and other publicly accessible sources, including price information agencies, publicly available market research results and market research commissioned by the contracting authority.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 12. Where the methods specified in part 1 of this Article cannot be used to determine the initial (maximum) contract price or the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), the contracting authority may use other methods. In that case, the contracting authority must include in its price justification an explanation of why the specified methods cannot be used.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 13. Goods, works or services having the same essential characteristics typical of them shall be considered identical. Minor differences in the appearance of goods may be disregarded when determining whether they are identical. When determining whether works or services are identical, the characteristics of the contractor or service provider and their business reputation in the market shall be considered.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 14. Goods shall be considered similar where, although not identical, they have similar characteristics and consist of similar components, allowing them to perform the same functions and/or be commercially interchangeable. Their quality, market reputation and country of origin shall be considered when determining similarity.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 15. Works or services shall be considered similar where, although not identical, they have similar characteristics allowing them to be commercially and/or functionally interchangeable. Their quality and market reputation, as well as their type, volume, uniqueness and commercial interchangeability, shall be considered when determining similarity.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 16. Commercial and/or financial terms for the supply of goods, performance of works or provision of services shall be considered comparable if differences between those terms do not materially affect the relevant results, or if those differences can be taken into account through appropriate adjustments to the terms.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 17. Whether goods, works or services to meet state and municipal needs are identical or similar, and whether commercial and/or financial terms for their supply, performance or provision are comparable, may be determined in accordance with the methodological recommendations provided for by part 20 of this Article.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 18. Publicly accessible information on prices of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs that may be used to determine the initial (maximum) contract price or the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) includes:
units.label: Part 18 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 1) price information contained in contracts that have been performed and under which no contractual penalties (fines or delay penalties) were recovered for failure to perform or improper performance of the contractual obligations;
units.label: Point 1 Part 18 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 2) price information in advertisements, catalogues, product descriptions and other offers addressed to an indefinite group of persons and recognized as public offers under civil legislation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 18 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 3) quotations on Russian exchanges;
units.label: Point 3 Part 18 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 4) quotations on electronic platforms;
units.label: Point 4 Part 18 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 5) state statistical reporting data on prices of goods, works and services;
units.label: Point 5 Part 18 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 6) price information contained in official information sources of authorized state and municipal bodies under legislation of the Russian Federation, legislation of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and municipal regulatory legal acts, or in official information sources of foreign states or international organizations or other publicly accessible publications;
units.label: Point 6 Part 18 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 7) information on the market value of valuation objects determined under legislation governing valuation activities in the Russian Federation or under legislation of foreign states;
units.label: Point 7 Part 18 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 8) information from price information agencies, publicly available market research results, and results of market research initiated by the contracting authority, including under a contract, provided that the price calculation methodology is disclosed, and other information sources.
units.label: Point 8 Part 18 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 18.1. Determining or justifying the initial (maximum) contract price or the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) in foreign currency is prohibited, except where those prices are justified and determined by a contracting authority operating in a foreign state.
units.label: Part 18.1 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 19. For particular types or groups of goods, works or services to meet state and municipal needs, the Government of the Russian Federation may establish an exhaustive list of information sources that may be used to determine the initial (maximum) contract price or the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider).
units.label: Part 19 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 20. Methodological recommendations on applying methods for determining the initial (maximum) contract price, the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and the initial unit price of goods, works or services shall be established by the federal executive body regulating the contractual procurement system.
units.label: Part 20 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 20.1. In addition to the methodological recommendations provided for by part 20 of this Article, the highest executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may establish methodological recommendations on applying methods for determining the initial (maximum) contract price, the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and the initial unit price of goods, works or services to meet the needs of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, including recommendations on justifying and applying other methods for determining those prices under part 12 of this Article.
units.label: Part 20.1 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 21. Special rules for determining the initial (maximum) contract price, the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and the initial unit price of goods, works or services in procurement to meet federal needs included in the state defence order shall be established in accordance with Federal Law of 29 December 2012 No. 275-FZ “On the State Defence Order”.
units.label: Part 21 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 21.1. Special rules for determining the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier, contractor or service provider when acquiring residential premises that meet the criteria for classification as standard housing established by the authorized federal executive body, and that are built on land plots transferred by the unified housing development institution for gratuitous use or lease for standard housing construction, for comprehensive territorial development that includes standard housing construction, or for construction of the minimum required volume of standard housing or comprehensive territorial development that includes such minimum standard housing construction and other housing construction, under Federal Law of 24 July 2008 No. 161-FZ “On Promoting Housing Construction, Creation of Tourism Infrastructure and Other Territorial Development”, shall be established by that Federal Law.
units.label: Part 21.1 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 21.2. Special rules for determining the initial (maximum) contract price and the price of a contract concluded with a sole contractor for works connected with regular carriage of passengers and baggage by road transport and urban ground electric transport shall be established by the federal law governing the organization of such regular carriage.
units.label: Part 21.2 Art. 22
